gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-lexend-exa: Cowboys traces every letter in one laser-etched line, with wide gaps between the stems. It earns its keep big and brief, while Lexend Exa follows with sturdy, open curves and stubby ascenders under a tall lowercase.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-lexend-giga: Lexend Giga reads wide and flat, each word loosened by generous tracking, with ascenders barely rising past the lowercase. Cowboys is the rustic, commanding one; the body font does the quiet talking.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-lexend-mega: Lexend Mega looks drawn with a single nib, its lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals and every c left visibly open. Lexend Mega is the friendly half here, while Cowboys supplies a rustic, authoritative edge with wide gaps between stems.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-lexend-tera: That laser-etched, constant-width trace is what defines Cowboys, with big gaps between neighboring stems. Lexend Tera answers it with plotter-pen lines and letters spaced like stepping stones, a rustic voice meeting a contemporary one.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-lexend-zetta: Rustic but tidy. Cowboys lays down an authoritative, etched line with generous stem gaps, and Lexend Zetta carries on in ribbon-like strokes, widely tracked, with tall-bodied small letters.
gen-dafont-cowboys-gf-montserrat-alterna: Montserrat Alternates has a lowercase that crowds the capital line. Cowboys sets it off with a laser-etched, constant-width trace and wide stem gaps, giving the pair a rustic, authoritative backbone beneath a contemporary body.
gen-dafont-deutsch-gothic-poppins: Deutsch Gothic packs its stems and curves tightly under a lofty lowercase band. It earns its keep big and short, and Poppins loosens everything up with rope-like curves and a sturdy, tall body.
gen-dafont-eraser-gf-cascadia-code: Understated and commanding, Eraser lays down bold letters without any thick-thin shifts. Cascadia Code follows with wire-thin monoline strokes and wide spacing, so lines of text move smoothly.
gen-dafont-eraser-gf-cascadia-mono: Cascadia Mono stands its letters like pins in a wide board. Eraser brings bold, uniform strokes up top, and the body's compact skyline of capitals and lowercase makes a tidy, steady page.
gen-dafont-eraser-gf-julius-sans-one: Bold, blunt and quietly confident, Eraser draws every stroke at the same thickness. And if the heading were made small, it would lose its punch next to Julius Sans One, whose open curves and wide letter gaps feel light.
